description: It reads what can be set on one webinar and what stands there right now: each settings group with its fields, the type of each field and its current value, plus the core facts such as type, status, date, time, timezone and room phase. Take it when a host wants to know the name of a setting, its value, or which values are allowed before something gets changed. "What is the setting called that controls my reminder?" You give the webinar id, or a group name when you only want the list of options for one area such as mails, ctas, schedule, replay, qa or design. It only reads and changes nothing. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: webinar settings, setting names, allowed values, mail slots

group.description: Optional: read the catalogue of ONE area instead of the stored values, e.g. mails, ctas, schedule, replay, qa, design.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Needed for the stored values; leave it out when you only want the catalogue of a group.

name: wi_get_webinar_settings
title: Read the settings of a webinar
